original_frontmatter.name: input-systems
original_frontmatter.description: Engine-neutral input architecture with Godot InputMap code: named actions, stick deadzones, buffered presses and rebinding with conflict checks. Use for controller support or a rebind menu, or a drifting stick, WASD on AZERTY, or a dropped press. Not for coyote time (`platformer`) or Unity and Unreal input assets (`unity-input-system`, `unreal-enhanced-input`).
